stop_unfounded.instructions: The executor ended its turn with a new stop line in its progress file: `stop_lines`. A valid stop names one of the allowed stop reasons `stop_reasons`, asks the operator a concrete question, and gives a resume line that says how the work continues once the question is answered. Does this stop line miss any of these three parts?

criteria.true: it names no allowed stop reason, or it has no question for the operator, or it has no resume line
criteria.false: it names an allowed stop reason, asks the operator a concrete question and says how to resume

head_incomplete.instructions: `progress_head` is the head of the executor's progress file at the end of a phase. It must say what is done, what the operator does next, and when the work will be finished. Does it fail to state any of these three?

criteria.true: what is done, the operator's next step, or when the work ends is missing or empty

evidence_contradicts.instructions: Feature `features[{i}].id` is done when: `features[{i}].done`. Its check printed `features[{i}].evidence_tail` — the end of the check output, the marker `features[{i}].marker` included. Does this evidence contradict the done clause, for example by reporting a failure, a skipped or not-run part of the done clause, or a subject other than the feature?

criteria.true: the evidence shows a failure, a skip, or something other than what the done clause describes
criteria.false: the evidence is consistent with the done clause
